notes:
ACCESS: Tier (a) direct HTTP (curl_cffi impersonate=chrome110) succeeded for robots.txt, /collections.json (288 collections across 2 pages), homepage, and every individual collection page - no block encountered, Playwright/Chrome not needed. robots.txt is standard Shopify boilerplate (User-agent: * / Allow: /, only /admin /cart /checkout /orders disallowed) - full access permitted. TREE METHOD: parsed the rendered header mega-menu markup embedded in the homepage HTML for the full top-level nav (Bottles & Flasks, Tableware, Lunch Boxes, Casseroles, Cookware, Storage [/collections/storage-containers-jars], Home Essentials, Electrical Appliances, Spare Parts - no Textile nav item anywhere). Under 'Storage' the mega-menu has exactly two child groups: 'Jars' (-> Glass Jars, PET Jars, Steel Jars, Spares for Jars) and 'Storage Containers' (-> Fridge Glass Containers). Cross-checked against the full 288-entry collections.json manifest and against each collection page's own embedded copy of the same mega-menu (confirms no additional subcategory tiles beyond the two groups). Every relevant page's rendered h1 matched the requested node name. Also found a large (158-link) 'related searches' footer block on the storage-containers-jars page listing extra jar attribute/tag collections (Mason Jars, Spice Jars, Honey Jars, Small/Big Jars, Airtight Jars, Snack Cookie Jars, Tea Coffee Sugar Container Jars, Food Storage, etc.) - verified this exact 158-link block is byte-identical on an unrelated page (bottles-flasks collection), proving it is a generic sitewide SEO footer, not a genuine page-specific sub-category strip, so none of those long-tail/attribute collections were added to the tree (they are not part of the actual site navigation hierarchy). QTY METHOD: read the server-rendered '

N products

' element on each collection page's own HTML (SSR, no JS needed) - this is the site's true displayed count and does NOT match the inflated/unreliable collections.json 'products_count' field for the same handles (e.g. jars: rendered 10 vs JSON 26; storage-containers: rendered 24 vs JSON 41), so the rendered ProductCount element was used exclusively per the project's known Shopify products_count unreliability. EXCLUDED AND WHY: 'Spares for Jars' (2 products) excluded as a spare/replacement-parts accessory category (lids/gaskets for jars), not itself a storage product, matching the project's convention of excluding all '(Spares for X)' accessory nodes (site also has a dedicated top-level 'Spare Parts' nav for these). All non-Storage top nav groups (Bottles & Flasks, Tableware, Lunch Boxes, Casseroles, Cookware, Electrical Appliances) are drinkware/kitchen-dining/cookware/appliances, excluded as Kitchen & Dining boundary. 'Home Essentials' group (Diyas, Buckets & Dustbins, Cleaning Products incl. Brooms, Cleaning Cloths, Floor Mops, Liquid Cleaners, Scrubbers, Spin Mops, Wipers) excluded: diyas are decorative lamps, buckets/dustbins are water/waste containers (primary purpose is not organizational storage per storage.md section 23), and all cleaning products/tools are excluded per storage.md section 30 (tools themselves, not storage racks for them). 'Gifts' collections (Raksha Bandhan, Corporate Gifting, Wedding, Birthday, Anniversary, House Warming, Diwali, etc.) excluded as gift/promotional landing pages. No Textile category, sub-nav, or product type (bedding, curtains, rugs, cushions, towels, table linens) exists anywhere in the mega-menu or the 288-collection manifest - Milton is a pure insulated-ware/houseware/drinkware brand (same profile as SR218 Cello World in this batch) with zero qualifying Textile nodes.
